$comment: Human-readable text for walk-corner 0.1.0 on hallway-corner 0.1.0 (specs #40, Part B step 9). Text only; README.md stays normative. success_criteria are in journey order, and each text starts with the card label from Art's answer on #40. world.dimensions.length is the length of route-centreline, because the world has no single straight length.

mission.title: Walk around the corner
mission.description: The robot walks down one hallway, turns the corner, and reaches the end of the next hallway. It starts at the entrance and is commanded to walk forward at 0.5 m/s while the runner steers it along the route. It must pass through the corner and reach the exit, 5.5 m along the route, within 27 s, staying upright, never touching a wall, and staying within its limit of the route.

success_criteria.text: Turns the corner: passes through the corner square before reaching the exit.
Stays on the route: never strays further from the route than its limit.
Clears the walls: never touches a wall.
Stays upright: the base never drops below the fall height.
Reaches the exit in time: 5.5 m along the route, within 27 s, crossing it inside the exit segment.

mission.grading: One run is one or more identical trials at the exact nominal pose. The default is 1. A grading policy turns completed trial outcomes into the run grade. ERROR is a test-system status reported on the job and on the trial. It is never a robot grade and is never counted as a robot fail. If no trial completes because of test-system errors, the run is not evaluated and the grade is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. A failed trial is not retried.
mission.time_limit_explained: 27 s is twice the time the route takes at the commanded speed, plus 5 s (2 × 5.5 m ÷ 0.5 m/s + 5 s).

world.title: Corner hallway
world.description: Two straight, empty hallways, each 1.50 m wide between the walls, meeting at a right angle, with 2.50 m-high walls. The route runs 6.00 m down the middle of both: 3.00 m to the centre of the corner square, then 3.00 m to the exit. Nothing else is in it: the test is whether the robot can follow the route around the corner.

lateral_limit.text: How far the robot's centre may stray from the route before its side would reach a wall in a straight hallway: half the clear width minus half the robot's width. Outside the corner it is measured from the turn point, so there it is stricter than the walls.
lateral_limit.sentence: {robot} may stray up to {value} m from the route: half the {clear_width} m hallway, minus half its {robot_width} m width.

exit_segment.text: The exit counts only when the robot's base crosses it between the walls, within half the clear width of the route.

fall_height.text: The lowest base height that still counts as upright, declared by the selected configuration.

fits_width.text: Checked before any trial: the robot fits when its width plus the wall clearance on each side (0.05 m for a humanoid, 0.10 m for a quadruped) is at most the clear width. A robot that does not fit is UNSUPPORTED, not run.
